summary: All 19 deposited rat PVN libraries match the registered cohort. The authors report SHR-versus-Wistar effects separately by sex, and Figure 5F averages those effects for selected genes. No public author result located estimates HypoExplorer’s joint sex-adjusted strain coefficient, so concordance remains unassessed. [Journal article and Figure 5](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13293-026-00855-3)
openIssues: Reopen if the authors release gene-level SHR-versus-Wistar coefficients estimated jointly across these libraries with sex adjustment.
The evidence files are saved and hash-verified locally. This checkout’s Git exclude rule hides the evidence directory from ordinary Git status.
